WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sm.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) as avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.entrystat
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_faces) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.zoneref,
    step1.entrystat,
    step1.avg_faces,
    step1.avg_faces - step2.overall_avg as dev_from_overall
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_faces) as avg_faces_by_status
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.zoneref,
    step3.entrystat,
    step3.avg_faces,
    step3.dev_from_overall,
    step3.avg_faces - step4.avg_faces_by_status as dev_from_status_avg
  FROM step3
  JOIN step4 ON step3.entrystat = step4.entrystat
  WHERE step3.avg_faces > step4.avg_faces_by_status
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_faces) as result_col1,
  AVG(dev_from_overall) as result_col2,
  AVG(dev_from_status_avg) as result_col3
FROM step5
